source_branches.when: no API key; invalid, expired or inactive token; inactive user
source_branches.observable: No key returns 401. A supplied but invalid key returns 403. A valid token updates api_tokens.last_used before project permission checks. Session cookies do not authenticate this API.

source_branches.when: active project membership and tenant scope
source_branches.observable: Safe GET permission requires a live active ProjectMember matching requester, workspace slug and project UUID; any project role including guest is allowed. Workspace membership is irrelevant. Missing, inactive or soft-deleted membership and wrong slug/project return 403 before queryset lookup.

State.objects excludes deleted states and group=triage. The queryset also filters exact workspace slug/project UUID, active membership and is_triage=false, excludes archived projects, select_related project/workspace and DISTINCTs rows. It does not explicitly exclude soft-deleted projects or workspaces. Archived project gives an empty list; soft-deleted project/workspace behavior must be retained from recorder evidence.

State.Meta orders by sequence ascending. The list uses BasePaginator with per_page default 1000 and max 1000; cursor is limit:page-index:is-prev, offset is page-index times per_page, with next and previous cursor metadata. Malformed cursor/per_page and values above 1000 return 400. per_page=0 and negative per_page are source edge probes; preserve observed runtime status and body.

StateSerializer emits all model fields by default. Exact comma-split fields are applied before expand; unknown fields disappear, empty selection means all, and whitespace is not trimmed. Only selected fields are expandable. BaseSerializer maps created_by/updated_by to UserLiteSerializer, workspace to WorkspaceLiteSerializer and project to ProjectLiteSerializer; a selected ordinary field named in expand is overwritten by its <field>_id value or null. Confirm null relation expansion from recorder output.

Success returns the BasePaginator envelope with nullable grouped_by, sub_grouped_by and extra_stats, page counts/cursors and serialized State rows. Authenticated user timezone is activated after authentication, permissions and throttling and affects serialized datetimes. Invalid timezone follows BaseAPIView KeyError handling and returns 400.

source_branches.when: query parameters not used by this view
source_branches.observable: No state filter, search, grouping or order_by query handling is defined; those values are ignored. List supports only cursor, per_page, fields and expand.

ApiKeyRateThrottle uses cache key api_key:<raw API key>, stores sliding request timestamps, and returns 429 at the configured limit. Allowed requests receive X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset. Permission denial occurs before throttle consumption.

After a response, every nonempty X-Api-Key request reaching APITokenLogMiddleware enqueues one durable plane.bgtasks.logger_task.process_logs Celery task with HMAC token identifier, redacted sensitive headers, request/response metadata and bodies. No worker runs and no APIActivityLog row is written in-request. CorsMiddleware short-circuits a valid preflight before the audit middleware, so preflight enqueues nothing.
The view declares use_read_replica=true; safe method reads use the configured replica while APIToken.last_used write uses the primary. No state/domain row is written by GET.
The URL view allows only GET and POST. HEAD and ordinary OPTIONS are not handlers and return 405; CORS preflight is handled by the outer CorsMiddleware.

A missing, soft-deleted, triage, wrong-project, wrong-workspace or archived-project state raises DoesNotExist and returns 404. StateSerializer emits every model field by default. Although OpenAPI documents no query parameters for detail, BaseAPIView still applies fields and expand: exact comma-split fields before expansion; unknown fields disappear, empty selection means all, whitespace is not trimmed. Only selected fields expand; known relations map to user/workspace/project lite serializers, while a selected ordinary field named in expand becomes its <field>_id or null. Other query parameters including cursor/per_page are ignored.

Success returns one StateSerializer object with authenticated user's timezone applied to datetime fields. Invalid timezone returns 400 through BaseAPIView KeyError handling. Detail's get_queryset().get missing-object path returns 404 with the BaseAPIView not-found body.

The same API-key throttle/cache and post-response process_logs effect apply as for list. Every nonempty API key request reaching the middleware is audited; anonymous and CORS-preflight short circuits are not. The request has no state/domain writes; a valid token updates api_tokens.last_used.
The URL view allows only GET, PATCH and DELETE. HEAD and ordinary OPTIONS return 405; outer CORS handles preflight. GET uses the read replica for reads; last_used persists on primary.
